high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "tooonytoony" from Primošten, Croatia. The post was made 2 days ago at 11:16 AM, as indicated by the timestamp in the top left corner of the screen. The photo is a black-and-white image capturing a dynamic scene on a rocky beach. In the foreground, there is a woman sitting on a rock, wearing a bikini and sunglasses, looking out towards the sea. She appears relaxed and contemplative. Above her, a man is captured mid-air, seemingly diving or jumping off the cliff into the water below.
